content:
Do we have a guide for determine which paramters should be implicit/explicit when contributing to Mathlib? So far I have been following rules found in existing codebase and advise from reviewers, but it would be great if this could be codified.

Some rules that I remembered are

  • if parameter A is part of the type of a parameter B, then A can be implicit
  • if A appears in both sides of an iff statement then A can be implicit
  • in a def if A appears appears in the type of a hypothesis B, A should still stay explicit (unless it also appears in a non-Prop type of C)
@Yaël Dillies had a draft guide written somewhere --- I still think this would be great to have (even if some bikeshedding of details is required to agree on everything).
Indeed, it would be nice to finish off
